LOGIN.NETWORK_ERROR: No signal. Check your connection and try again.
LOGIN.BIOMETRIC_PROMPT: Confirm your identity to sign in
LOGIN.BIOMETRIC_OFFER_BODY: Open the app with your fingerprint or face? Your password and code are still asked when the session expires.
LOGIN.BIOMETRIC_ENABLE_PROMPT: Confirm your identity to turn on «Open with fingerprint»
LOGIN.ACCESS_NOT_PROVISIONED: Your user is not set up in the system. Contact the administrator and show them the code below.
LOGIN.ACCESS_INACTIVE: Your user is deactivated. Contact the administrator.
LOGIN.BROWSER_BODY: We sent an email to {{email}}. Tap the link in the email to confirm this phone and sign in again.
LOGIN.BROWSER_NOT_SENT: The confirmation email could not be sent.
LOGIN.ONBOARDING_BODY: Complete your first sign-in on the Teikem web (email and your own password) and come back here.

ORDERS.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search: reference, order, waybill, piece, name or phone
ORDERS.SCAN_HINT: Point the camera at the barcode on the label.
ORDERS.FILTER_SENDER_REQUIRED: Select at least one sender to search.
ORDERS.MORE_RESULTS: {{count}} more results. Narrow the filters to see them.
ORDERS.SEARCH_ERROR: The search could not be completed. Try again.

MANIFESTS.COMPANY_FAILED: No answer from: {{names}}. What you see for that company may be out of date.

SHIPMENT_DETAILS.MAP_NOT_LOCATED: Address could not be located on the map

DELIVERY.MISSING_SIGNATURE: Capture the signature and press "Save signature".
DELIVERY.DELIVERED_BODY: Queued; it will be sent when the connection is back.
DELIVERY.DELIVERED_QUEUED: Offline: it will be sent when reconnected.
DELIVERY.LOCATION_BODY: Are you at the delivery address?
DELIVERY.ERROR: Could not record the delivery. Try again.
DELIVERY.CAMERA_PERMISSION: Enable camera permission to take the photo.

CHAT.TITLE: Messages
CHAT.EMPTY: You have no conversations yet. Tap “New” to write to the office.
CHAT.NO_PEOPLE: There is nobody to write to.
CHAT.MAX_PHOTOS: A message can carry up to 4 photos.
CHAT.NEEDS_CONNECTION: You need a connection to start a conversation. Try again.
CHAT.SEND_ERROR: The message could not be saved.
CHAT.ORDER_GONE: That shipment is no longer in your routes.

PICKUP.TITLE: Pick up shipment
PICKUP.GIVER_PLACEHOLDER: Name of the person handing it over
PICKUP.PICKED_QUEUED: No signal: the pickup will be sent automatically when you are back online.
PICKUP.ERROR: The pickup could not be recorded.

ACTIONS.EXCEPTION_QUEUED: Offline: it will be sent when reconnected.
ACTIONS.EXCEPTION_ERROR: Could not record the exception. Try again.
ACTIONS.NO_BARCODES: Shipment pieces not found. Open the Pieces tab and try again.
ACTIONS.ACCEPT_FIRST: Accept the manifest first: it has not started yet.
ACTIONS.COD_PENDING_NOTE: the collection is recorded with the office
ACTIONS.COD_EXCEEDS: You cannot collect more than what is left ({{pending}}).

UPDATE.REQUIRED_BODY: This version of the app is no longer supported. Download the new version to continue.
UPDATE.AVAILABLE_BODY: A new version ({{version}}) is available. Download it now?

PROFILE.LOGOUT_PENDING_BODY: You have {{count}} record(s) not yet sent to the server. If you log out now they WILL BE LOST. Get back online and try again.
PROFILE.BIOMETRIC_DISABLE_CONFIRM: You will need to type your password next time. Disable?
PROFILE.BIOMETRIC_ENABLE_HINT: Locks the app after a few minutes away and opens it with your fingerprint or face. Password and code are asked when the session expires.
PROFILE.COMPANY_SWITCH_BODY: You will switch to {{name}}. Anything not yet sent is sent first and that company's manifests are loaded.
PROFILE.COMPANY_BLOCKED: Sign in again with your password and code
PROFILE.COMPANY_SWITCH_PENDING: You have {{count}} record(s) not yet sent to this company. Connect to the internet to send them, then switch companies.

ONBOARDING.EMAIL_BODY: We will send a 6-digit code to {{email}}.
ONBOARDING.PASSWORD_BODY: Choose your own password; the one you were given stops working.
ONBOARDING.MFA_BODY: You still need to set up two-step verification with your authenticator app.

MFA.TITLE: Two-step verification
MFA.SUBTITLE: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or one of your recovery codes.
MFA.DEV_CODE: Development only: your current code is {{code}}
MFA.ENROLL_SUBTITLE: Your company requires a second factor. Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) and type the code it shows.
MFA.RECOVERY_BODY: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.

LEGAL.TITLE: Privacy and terms of use
LEGAL.LEAD: Read the document to the end to be able to accept it.
LEGAL.SCROLL_HINT: Scroll to the end to enable «I accept».
LEGAL.ERROR: The document could not be loaded.

LOCK.TITLE: App locked
LOCK.HELP: Use your fingerprint or face to open it.
LOCK.PROMPT: Confirm your identity to open the app
LOCK.FAILED: It did not match. Attempts left: {{left}}.

ACCEPT.TITLE: Accept manifest
ACCEPT.HINT: On accepting, the route starts and the shipments go In transit. If you will not carry one, mark it and pick the reason.
ACCEPT.REASON_REQUIRED: Pick the reason for every shipment you do not accept.
ACCEPT.CONFIRM_BODY: You accept {{accepted}} shipment(s) and decline {{declined}}. Confirm?
ACCEPT.DONE_BODY: The route started: {{accepted}} shipment(s) in transit, {{declined}} declined.
ACCEPT.DONE_NONE: You accepted no shipment: the route did not start and the office will decide.
ACCEPT.NO_SIGNAL: No connection. Accepting the manifest needs signal.
ACCEPT.NOT_FOUND: This manifest is no longer available.

TRACKING.DISCLOSURE_BODY: While you have a route in progress, the app saves your location even with the screen off or the app closed, and sends it to the company office for route monitoring and customer service. It is only recorded during an active route, kept for 10 days, and you can turn it off in Profile (the office gets a notice). Android will ask for location permission; to keep going with the screen off choose "Allow all the time".
TRACKING.NOTIFICATION_BODY: Sending your location to the office.
TRACKING.PROFILE_LABEL: Send my location during the route
TRACKING.PROFILE_HINT: Only while you have a route in progress. If you turn it off, the office gets a notice. To save battery, do not restrict this app's battery in the phone settings.
TRACKING.OFF_BODY: The office will stop seeing your route and will get a notice that you turned it off. Confirm?
TRACKING.BANNER_OFF: Your location is off during the route. The office cannot see your trip and was notified.
TRACKING.BANNER_PERMISSION: The app has no location permission. Turn it on in the phone settings so the office can see your route.
